_comment: App settings shared by Android and iOS — bundled into both apps at build time and read at
start-up, like page-operations.json. Change a value here and rebuild the apps.
A setting that is missing, or the whole file, falls back to the default written in the code,
so an older file keeps working with a newer app. See Documentation/Configuration.md.
layout: share of the screen height each header takes (0.20 = 20%). The person page's header
shrinks from person_header_expanded to person_header_collapsed while scrolling.
lists: how many open items Home shows, and how many after See all.
profile_photo: pictures are resized on the phone to at most max_px on the long side before upload.
designations: the choices offered when an administrator adds a doctor (any other can be typed).
message_cache: discussions kept on the phone so they can be read without the server.
max_mb   total size allowed. trim_mb   how much of the oldest data is removed when it is full.
file_cache: full images and PDFs opened in the viewer (thumbnails are cached separately).
Not here: upload limits (files per item, image and PDF size). The apps read those from the
server (Server/config/server.json), so they can change without rebuilding the apps.
